Cell.Data: This is the data file for the curriculum lesson menu for POM Runner mobile game
One table in the document, tnSubjectList
Each record cotains the display string and rollover vo for the subject button, and the table name to find the assicated skills
One table per record in tnSubjectList.
Each record lists the kid and parent display string for the skill, along with the vo for the kid string. It also has a refernece to the Lesson table used for this skill
Contains the visible name and rollover vo for the lessons/Level buttons, plus a boolean indicating if the level is active, and the LessonID
There is a special instance of this table, tnGamePlay, that is not referenced in any tsSkills table
all tfXXID fields are unique integers assigned to each Activity/Skill/Lesson. Corresponds to values in the Access content database, and is used for record keeping
